ships.name: 110_learned_q4_minutes
ships.summary: Replaced heuristic foul_trouble_factor with learned Q4 minutes from MinuteTrajectoryModel for all period=4 players. 7/7 win, WF 4/4.

ships.name: 112_quantile_recal
ships.summary: Recalibrated quantile bands against new tighter endQ3 projections; 7/7 stats at endQ2 AND endQ3 hit 0.80 coverage target.

ships.name: R1_D_v2_per_player_quantile_variance
ships.summary: Per-player variance-modulated quantile bands. Spread -0.0725 (gate -0.03). 7/7 stats at 0.80 overall coverage. Per-stat rescales [0.87-1.01].

ships.name: R2_F_residual_heads
ships.summary: LightGBM residual heads on top of cycle-110 baseline at endQ3. PTS -0.0965 MAE, REB -0.046, AST -0.036, FG3M -0.048, STL -0.054, BLK -0.033, TOV -0.050. WF 4/4 folds negative (-0.082 to -0.107). 14 features (current stats + pf + min + score margin + position).

ships.name: R3_A_residual_heads_endq2
ships.summary: Residual heads at endQ2 (mirror of R2_F at endQ3). PTS -0.1095, REB -0.082, AST -0.064, FG3M -0.046, STL -0.105, BLK -0.062, TOV -0.078. WF 4/4 negative.

ships.name: R3_E_endq2_minute_in_head
ships.summary: Bounded learned-minute scaling at endQ2 via minute_trajectory_q2.lgb. PTS -0.025 at endQ2, 6/7 wins. SHIP candidate but deferring to R4 to test composition with R3_A first.

ships.name: R4_A_residual_heads_endq1
ships.summary: Residual heads at endQ1 (3rd snapshot point). PTS -0.1182, REB -0.023, AST -0.051, FG3M -0.038, STL -0.056, BLK -0.080, TOV -0.026. 7/7 wins, WF 4/4 (-0.09 to -0.12).
